concept.description: Labels all types annotated with @javax.servlet.annotation.WebFilter with "ServletAPI", "Web", "Filter", "JEE" and "Injectable".
concept.cypher: MATCH (webFilter:Java:Type)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->()-[:OF_TYPE]-(:Java:Type {fqn: "javax.servlet.annotation.WebFilter"}) SET webFilter:ServletAPI:Web:Filter:JEE:Injectable RETURN webFilter AS WebFilter

concept.description: Labels all types annotated with @javax.servlet.annotation.WebServlet with "ServletAPI", "Web", "Servlet", "JEE" and "Injectable".
concept.cypher: MATCH (webServlet:Java:Type)-[:ANNOTATED_BY]->()-[:OF_TYPE]-(:Java:Type {fqn: "javax.servlet.annotation.WebServlet"}) SET webServlet:ServletAPI:Web:Servlet:JEE:Injectable RETURN webServlet AS WebServlet
